```text
18	func newRetireCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
19		var (
20			closeUnknown    bool
21			assumeNoRuntime bool
22			deleteBranch    bool
23			timeout         time.Duration
24		)
25		cmd := &cobra.Command{
26			Use:   "retire [task-or-worktree]",
27			Short: "Close runtime state and safely remove an integrated worktree",
28			Long: `Retire local execution state after a change has been integrated.
29	
30	Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
31	covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
32	runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
33	without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.
34	
35	Unknown runtime status fails closed. An external coordinator may acknowledge it
36	with --close-unknown; working, blocked and waiting agents are never overridden.`,
37			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
38			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
39				ctx := ctxOf()
40				target, rt, err := resolveRetirementTarget(ctx, app, args)
41				if err != nil {
42					return err
43				}
44				if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, target.CheckoutPath); err != nil {
45					return err
46				}
47				service := &retirement.Service{Runtime: rt, Tasks: app.Tasks}
48				result, err := service.Retire(ctx, retirement.Request{
49					Target: target,
50					Safety: retirement.Options{
51						CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
52					},
53					DeleteBranch: deleteBranch,
54				})
55				if err != nil {
56					return err
57				}
58				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "RETIRED %s\n", config.Contract(target.CheckoutPath))
59				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   runtime  %d session(s) closed\n", result.ClosedSessions)
60				if result.RemovedWorktree {
61					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   worktree removed")
62				}
63				if result.DeletedBranch {
64					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   branch   %s deleted\n", target.Branch)
65				}
66				if result.DeletedTask {
67					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   task     %s reaped\n", target.TaskID)
68				}
69				return nil
70			},
71		}
72		f := cmd.Flags()
73		f.BoolVar(&closeUnknown, "close-unknown", false, "allow an external caller to close unknown/empty runtime status")
74		f.BoolVar(&assumeNoRuntime, "assume-no-runtime", false, "continue when runtime enumeration fails (external callers only)")
75		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranch, "delete-branch", false, "delete the contained local branch after worktree removal")
76		f.DurationVar(&timeout, "timeout", 5*time.Second, "maximum time to wait for runtime sessions to close")
77		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Done)
78		return cmd
79	}
80	
81	func resolveRetirementTarget(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string) (retirement.Target, runtime.Runtime, error) {
82		if len(args) == 1 {
83			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
84			if info, statErr := os.Stat(expanded); statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
85				return retirementTargetForPath(ctx, app, expanded)
86			}
87			t, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
88			if err != nil {
89				return retirement.Target{}, nil, err
90			}
91			return retirementTargetForTask(ctx, app, t)
92		}
93		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
94		if err != nil {
95			return retirement.Target{}, nil, err
96		}
97		if t, taskErr := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd); taskErr == nil {
98			return retirementTargetForTask(ctx, app, t)
99		}
100		return retirementTargetForPath(ctx, app, cwd)
101	}
102	
103	func retirementTargetForTask(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task) (retirement.Target, runtime.Runtime, error) {
104		if t.State != task.Done {
105			return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("task %s is %s, not merged; run dev done first", t.ID, t.State)
106		}
107		base := t.Base
108		if base == "" {
109			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, t.RepoPath)
110		}
111		checkout := t.RepoPath
112		linked := false
113		rt := runtimeForTask(app, t)
114		if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree {
115			if t.WorktreePath != "" {
116				checkout, linked = t.WorktreePath, true
117			} else {
118				if t.RuntimeHandle != "" {
119					return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("task %s has a runtime handle but no worktree path; reconcile it before retirement", t.ID)
120				}
121				rt = runtime.None{}
122			}
123		}
124		return retirement.Target{
125			TaskID: t.ID, RepoPath: t.RepoPath, CheckoutPath: checkout,
126			Branch: t.Branch, Base: base, LinkedWorktree: linked,
127		}, rt, nil
128	}
129	
130	func retirementTargetForPath(ctx context.Context, app *App, path string) (retirement.Target, runtime.Runtime, error) {
131		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path)
132		if err != nil {
133			return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve worktree %s: %w", config.Contract(path), err)
134		}
135		if !repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
136			return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not a linked worktree; retire explicit paths only from their linked checkout", config.Contract(path))
137		}
138		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
139		if err != nil {
140			return retirement.Target{}, nil, err
141		}
142		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
143			return retirement.Target{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire detached worktree %s; preserve or branch its commit first", config.Contract(path))
144		}
145		base := gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.MainRoot)
146		return retirement.Target{
147			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, CheckoutPath: repository.Root,
148			Branch: status.Branch, Base: base, LinkedWorktree: true,
149		}, app.Runtime(), nil
150	}
151	
152	func safeRemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, rt runtime.Runtime, repoPath, path string, force bool,
153		closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration,
154	) error {
155		if _, err := retirement.CloseAndWait(ctx, rt, path, retirement.Options{
156			CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
157		}); err != nil {
158			return err
159		}
160		if dirty, status, err := wt.DirtyCheck(ctx, path); err != nil {
161			return err
162		} else if dirty && !force {
163			return fmt.Errorf("%s has uncommitted changes (%s)", config.Contract(path), status.Breakdown())
164		}
165		return gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, repoPath, path, force)
166	}
```

```text
1	package retire
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"os"
8	
9		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
13	)
14	
15	// Target is the live Git/task identity retirement must revalidate before every
16	// destructive stage.
17	type Target struct {
18		TaskID         string
19		RepoPath       string
20		CheckoutPath   string
21		Branch         string
22		Base           string
23		LinkedWorktree bool
24	}
25	
26	// Request is one externally coordinated retirement attempt.
27	type Request struct {
28		Target       Target
29		Safety       Options
30		DeleteBranch bool
31	}
32	
33	// Result records which terminal resources were removed.
34	type Result struct {
35		ClosedSessions  int
36		RemovedWorktree bool
37		DeletedBranch   bool
38		DeletedTask     bool
39	}
40	
41	// Service owns cleanup policy; every caller must use a freshly selected runtime.
42	type Service struct {
43		Runtime runtime.Runtime
44		Tasks   *task.Store
45	}
46	
47	// Retire closes live runtime surfaces, waits for them to release the checkout,
48	// then removes only a validated linked worktree and finally its task record.
49	func (s *Service) Retire(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Result, error) {
50		target, err := s.validateTarget(ctx, req.Target)
51		if err != nil {
52			return Result{}, err
53		}
54		inspection, err := CloseAndWait(ctx, s.Runtime, target.CheckoutPath, req.Safety)
55		if err != nil {
56			return Result{}, err
57		}
58		result := Result{ClosedSessions: inspection.ClosedSessions}
59	
60		// Reality may change while a runtime is draining. Never carry the earlier
61		// worktree/dirty/ancestry proof across that boundary.
62		target, err = s.validateTarget(ctx, target)
63		if err != nil {
64			return result, fmt.Errorf("revalidate after runtime close: %w", err)
65		}
66		finalInspection, err := Inspect(ctx, s.Runtime, target.CheckoutPath, req.Safety)
67		if err != nil {
68			return result, fmt.Errorf("reinspect after runtime close: %w", err)
69		}
70		if !finalInspection.Ready() || len(finalInspection.Sessions) > 0 {
71			return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime reclaimed the checkout after closure; refusing worktree removal")
72		}
73		if target.LinkedWorktree {
74			if err := gitx.RemoveWorktree(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.CheckoutPath, false); err != nil {
75				return result, err
76			}
77			result.RemovedWorktree = true
78		}
79		if req.DeleteBranch && target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != target.Base && gitx.BranchExists(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.Branch) {
80			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.RepoPath, "branch", "-d", target.Branch); err != nil {
81				return result, fmt.Errorf("delete merged branch %s: %w", target.Branch, err)
82			}
83			result.DeletedBranch = true
84		}
85		if target.TaskID != "" && s.Tasks != nil {
86			if err := s.validateTaskIdentity(target); err != nil {
87				return result, fmt.Errorf("revalidate task before deletion: %w", err)
88			}
89			if err := s.Tasks.Delete(target.TaskID); err != nil {
90				return result, fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", target.TaskID, err)
91			}
92			result.DeletedTask = true
93		}
94		return result, nil
95	}
96	
97	func (s *Service) validateTarget(ctx context.Context, target Target) (Target, error) {
98		if target.RepoPath == "" || target.CheckoutPath == "" {
99			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("retirement target needs repository and checkout paths")
100		}
101		var err error
102		target.RepoPath, err = pathx.Canonical(target.RepoPath)
103		if err != nil {
104			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize repository: %w", err)
105		}
106		target.CheckoutPath, err = pathx.Canonical(target.CheckoutPath)
107		if err != nil {
108			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize checkout: %w", err)
109		}
110		if target.Base == "" {
111			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot prove integration without a base branch")
112		}
113		if err := s.validateTaskIdentity(target); err != nil {
114			return Target{}, err
115		}
116		if _, statErr := os.Stat(target.CheckoutPath); statErr == nil {
117			if operation, active, operationErr := gitx.InProgress(target.CheckoutPath); operationErr != nil {
118				return Target{}, operationErr
119			} else if active {
120				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing retirement while Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
121			}
122		} else if !errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
123			return Target{}, statErr
124		}
125		if target.LinkedWorktree && target.Branch == "" {
126			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire a detached linked worktree")
127		}
128		if target.Branch != "" && target.Branch != target.Base {
129			if !gitx.BranchExists(ctx, target.RepoPath, target.Branch) {
130				if target.TaskID == "" {
131					return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s no longer exists; only a persisted done task may reconcile it", target.Branch)
132				}
133			} else if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, target.RepoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", target.Branch, target.Base); err != nil {
134				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("branch %s is not contained in %s", target.Branch, target.Base)
135			}
136		}
137	
138		if !target.LinkedWorktree {
139			return target, nil
140		}
141		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, target.RepoPath)
142		if err != nil {
143			return Target{}, err
144		}
145		registered := false
146		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
147			path, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
148			if canonicalErr != nil || path != target.CheckoutPath {
149				continue
150			}
151			registered = true
152			if worktree.Main {
153				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("refusing to retire main checkout %s", target.CheckoutPath)
154			}
155			if worktree.Branch != target.Branch {
156				return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("worktree %s is on %s, expected %s", target.CheckoutPath, worktree.Branch, target.Branch)
157			}
158			break
159		}
160		if !registered {
161			if _, statErr := os.Stat(target.CheckoutPath); errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
162				if err := gitx.PruneWorktrees(ctx, target.RepoPath); err != nil {
163					return Target{}, err
164				}
165				target.LinkedWorktree = false
166				return target, nil
167			}
168			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("path %s exists but Git no longer registers it; preserve orphaned artifacts before cleanup", target.CheckoutPath)
169		}
170		dirty, status, err := wtDirty(ctx, target.CheckoutPath)
171		if err != nil {
172			return Target{}, err
173		}
174		if dirty {
175			return Target{}, fmt.Errorf("worktree %s is not clean: %s", target.CheckoutPath, status.Breakdown())
176		}
177		return target, nil
178	}
179	
180	func (s *Service) validateTaskIdentity(target Target) error {
181		if target.TaskID == "" {
182			return nil
183		}
184		if s.Tasks == nil {
185			return fmt.Errorf("retirement target %s needs its task store for identity revalidation", target.TaskID)
186		}
187		current, err := s.Tasks.Get(target.TaskID)
188		if err != nil {
189			return fmt.Errorf("reload retirement task %s: %w", target.TaskID, err)
190		}
191		if current.State != task.Done {
192			return fmt.Errorf("task %s changed state to %s during retirement", target.TaskID, current.State)
193		}
194		repoPath, err := pathx.Canonical(current.RepoPath)
195		if err != nil {
196			return err
197		}
198		checkoutPath := current.RepoPath
199		if current.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && current.WorktreePath != "" {
200			checkoutPath = current.WorktreePath
201		}
202		checkoutPath, err = pathx.Canonical(checkoutPath)
203		if err != nil {
204			return err
205		}
206		if repoPath != target.RepoPath || checkoutPath != target.CheckoutPath || current.Branch != target.Branch {
207			return fmt.Errorf("task %s checkout identity changed during retirement", target.TaskID)
208		}
209		if current.Base != "" && current.Base != target.Base {
210			return fmt.Errorf("task %s base changed from %s to %s during retirement", target.TaskID, target.Base, current.Base)
211		}
212		return nil
213	}
214	
215	func wtDirty(ctx context.Context, path string) (bool, gitx.Status, error) {
216		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, path)
217		if err != nil {
218			return false, status, err
219		}
220		return status.Dirty(), status, nil
221	}
222
```

```text
136	// renderStarterConfig fills the annotated template with detected paths.

141		}

144			"@@REPO_PATHS@@", quotedStrings(l.RepoPaths),
145			"@@TRIES_ROOT@@", l.TriesRoot,
146			"@@PROJECT_ROOT@@", l.ProjectRoot,
147			"@@WORKTREE_ROOT@@", l.WorktreeRoot,
148		)
149		return r.Replace(starterConfig)
150	}

152	func quotedStrings(values []string) string {
153		quoted := make([]string, len(values))
154		for index, value := range values {

156		}
157		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
```

```text
1	package fleet
2	
3	import (
4		"crypto/sha256"
5		"encoding/hex"
6		"encoding/json"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9		"strings"
10		"time"
11	
12		devconfig "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
13	)
14	
15	type cacheFile struct {
16		Version    int       `json:"version"`
17		EndpointID string    `json:"endpoint_id"`
18		FetchedAt  time.Time `json:"fetched_at"`
19		Snapshot   Snapshot  `json:"snapshot"`
20	}
21	
22	func CacheRoot() string { return filepath.Join(devconfig.CacheHome(), "dev", "fleet", "v1") }
23	
24	func cachePath(host Host) string {
25		name := devconfig.Slug(host.Name)
26		return filepath.Join(CacheRoot(), name+".json")
27	}
28	
29	func EndpointID(host Host) string {
30		parts := []string{host.Name, host.SSHAlias, host.Hostname, host.User, host.IdentityFile, host.DevPath}
31		parts = append(parts, time.Duration(host.ConnectTimeout.Duration).String(), time.Duration(host.CommandTimeout.Duration).String())
32		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "\x00")))
33		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
34	}
35	
36	func SaveCache(host Host, snapshot Snapshot) error {
37		path := cachePath(host)
38		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
39			return err
40		}
41		payload := cacheFile{Version: 1, EndpointID: EndpointID(host), FetchedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Snapshot: snapshot}
42		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(payload, "", "  ")
43		if err != nil {
44			return err
45		}
46		data = append(data, '\n')
47		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".fleet-*.tmp")
48		if err != nil {
49			return err
50		}
51		name := temporary.Name()
52		defer os.Remove(name)
53		if _, err := temporary.Write(data); err != nil {
54			_ = temporary.Close()
55			return err
56		}
57		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
58			return err
59		}
60		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
61			return err
62		}
63		return os.Rename(name, path)
64	}
65	
66	func LoadCache(host Host) (Snapshot, time.Time, bool) {
67		data, err := os.ReadFile(cachePath(host))
68		if err != nil {
69			return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
70		}
71		var payload cacheFile
72		if json.Unmarshal(data, &payload) != nil || payload.Version != 1 || payload.EndpointID != EndpointID(host) || payload.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
73			return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
74		}
75		if payload.Snapshot.SchemaVersion != SnapshotSchemaVersion {
76			return Snapshot{}, time.Time{}, false
77		}
78		return payload.Snapshot, payload.FetchedAt, true
79	}
80
```

```text
1	// Package inventory joins the three sources that describe work in progress:
2	// the task registry (human intent), git (durable code state) and the runtime
3	// (what is live right now). It is the single code path behind `dev ls`,
4	// `dev status`, `dev sweep` and the TUI, so all four can never disagree.
5	package inventory
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"os"
10		"sort"
11		"strings"
12		"sync"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/runtime"
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
18	)
19	
20	// Row is one task enriched with everything derived live.
21	type Row struct {
22		Task *task.Task
23	
24		// Checkout is where the task's code currently lives: its worktree if it
25		// has one, else the repo. Empty when nothing exists on disk.
26		Checkout string
27		// CheckoutExists reports whether that directory is actually present. A
28		// cold task, or one whose worktree was removed behind dev's back, is not.
29		CheckoutExists bool
30		// WorktreeMissing flags a task that records a worktree path which is no
31		// longer a registered git worktree — the drift `dev sweep` reports.
32		WorktreeMissing bool
33	
34		// Status is the live git status of Checkout. Zero when there is nothing
35		// on disk to inspect.
36		Status    gitx.Status
37		StatusErr error
38	
39		// LastCommit is the author time of HEAD, used to age a task.
40		LastCommit time.Time
41	
42		// Session is the live runtime session hosting this checkout, if any.
43		Session *runtime.Session
44		// sessionsTracked reports whether the runtime can observe sessions at all.
45		// With the "none" backend it cannot, so "hot but nothing live" is not
46		// drift — it is the only state that backend can ever produce.
47		sessionsTracked bool
48	}
49	
50	// Live reports whether a runtime session is currently hosting this task.
51	func (r Row) Live() bool { return r.Session != nil }
52	
53	// StateDrift reports a task whose recorded state disagrees with reality:
54	// hot with no live session, or warm/cold with one. It is what `dev sweep`
55	// turns into suggestions — dev reports drift and never silently rewrites it.
56	func (r Row) StateDrift() string {
57		if r.sessionsTracked {
58			switch r.Task.State {
59			case task.Hot:
60				if !r.Live() {
61					return "no live session"
62				}
63			case task.Warm, task.Cold:
64				if r.Live() {
65					return "session is live"
66				}
67			}
68		}
69		if r.Task.State == task.Cold && r.CheckoutExists && r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
70			return "worktree still on disk"
71		}
72		if r.WorktreeMissing {
73			return "worktree is gone"
74		}
75		return ""
76	}
77	
78	// Age is how long since the task's last commit, falling back to when the entry
79	// was last written for a task with no commits of its own.
80	func (r Row) Age() time.Duration {
81		ref := r.LastCommit
82		if ref.IsZero() || r.Task.Updated.After(ref) {
83			ref = r.Task.Updated
84		}
85		if ref.IsZero() {
86			return 0
87		}
88		return time.Since(ref)
89	}
90	
91	// Options tunes what a Collect call spends time on.
92	type Options struct {
93		// SkipRuntime avoids querying the multiplexer, for callers that only need
94		// git facts (and for tests).
95		SkipRuntime bool
96		// SkipGit avoids running git per task, for a fast listing.
97		SkipGit bool
98	}
99	
100	// Collect builds the enriched inventory. Git probes run concurrently: each is
101	// a handful of process spawns, and a machine with dozens of tasks would
102	// otherwise make `dev ls` feel slow.
103	func Collect(ctx context.Context, tasks []*task.Task, rt runtime.Runtime, opts Options) []Row {
104		rows := make([]Row, len(tasks))
105	
106		var sessions []runtime.Session
107		tracked := false
108		if !opts.SkipRuntime && rt != nil && rt.Name() != "none" {
109			if s, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil {
110				sessions, tracked = s, true
111			}
112		}
113	
114		var wg sync.WaitGroup
115		// Bound concurrency: git is process-heavy and an unbounded fan-out over a
116		// large inventory would thrash.
117		sem := make(chan struct{}, 8)
118	
119		for i, t := range tasks {
120			rows[i].Task = t
121			rows[i].Checkout = checkoutOf(t)
122	
123			if opts.SkipGit || rows[i].Checkout == "" {
124				continue
125			}
126			wg.Add(1)
127			go func(i int) {
128				defer wg.Done()
129				sem <- struct{}{}
130				defer func() { <-sem }()
131				enrich(ctx, &rows[i])
132			}(i)
133		}
134		wg.Wait()
135	
136		for i := range rows {
137			rows[i].Session = matchSession(sessions, rows[i])
138			rows[i].sessionsTracked = tracked
139		}
140		return rows
141	}
142	
143	func checkoutOf(t *task.Task) string {
144		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
145			return t.WorktreePath
146		}
147		return t.RepoPath
148	}
149	
150	func enrich(ctx context.Context, r *Row) {
151		info, err := os.Stat(r.Checkout)
152		r.CheckoutExists = err == nil && info.IsDir()
153		if !r.CheckoutExists {
154			if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
155				r.WorktreeMissing = true
156			}
157			return
158		}
159		if st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Checkout); err != nil {
160			r.StatusErr = err
161		} else {
162			r.Status = st
163		}
164		if unix, _, err := gitx.LastCommit(ctx, r.Checkout); err == nil && unix > 0 {
165			r.LastCommit = time.Unix(unix, 0)
166		}
167		// A recorded worktree that git no longer knows about is drift worth
168		// surfacing: the directory may exist while the administrative entry is gone.
169		if r.Task.WorktreePath != "" {
170			if _, ok, err := gitx.WorktreeFor(ctx, r.Task.RepoPath, r.Task.Branch); err == nil && !ok {
171				r.WorktreeMissing = true
172			}
173		}
174	}
175	
176	// matchSession picks the runtime session hosting a row's checkout. An exact
177	// directory match is preferred over a containing one, so a worktree's own
178	// session always wins over the parent repo's.
179	func matchSession(sessions []runtime.Session, r Row) *runtime.Session {
180		if r.Checkout == "" {
181			return nil
182		}
183		var contains *runtime.Session
184		for i := range sessions {
185			for _, d := range sessions[i].Dirs {
186				if d == r.Checkout {
187					return &sessions[i]
188				}
189				if strings.HasPrefix(d, r.Checkout+"/") && contains == nil {
190					contains = &sessions[i]
191				}
192			}
193		}
194		return contains
195	}
196	
197	// Filter narrows rows by state and repo. An empty filter matches everything.
198	type Filter struct {
199		States []task.State
200		Repo   string
201		// LiveOnly keeps only tasks with a runtime session.
202		LiveOnly bool
203		// DirtyOnly keeps only tasks with uncommitted work.
204		DirtyOnly bool
205	}
206	
207	// Apply returns the rows matching f.
208	func (f Filter) Apply(rows []Row) []Row {
209		out := rows[:0:0]
210		for _, r := range rows {
211			if len(f.States) > 0 && !containsState(f.States, r.Task.State) {
212				continue
213			}
214			if f.Repo != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Task.Repo), strings.ToLower(f.Repo)) {
215				continue
216			}
217			if f.LiveOnly && !r.Live() {
218				continue
219			}
220			if f.DirtyOnly && !r.Status.Dirty() {
221				continue
222			}
223			out = append(out, r)
224		}
225		return out
226	}
227	
228	func containsState(list []task.State, s task.State) bool {
229		for _, v := range list {
230			if v == s {
231				return true
232			}
233		}
234		return false
235	}
236	
237	// Orphans reports live runtime sessions that no task claims — the "I opened
238	// this and never wrote it down" case that makes a sidebar grow without bound.
239	func Orphans(sessions []runtime.Session, rows []Row) []runtime.Session {
240		claimed := map[string]bool{}
241		for _, r := range rows {
242			if r.Session != nil {
243				claimed[r.Session.Handle] = true
244			}
245		}
246		var out []runtime.Session
247		for _, s := range sessions {
248			if !claimed[s.Handle] {
249				out = append(out, s)
250			}
251		}
252		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Label < out[j].Label })
253		return out
254	}
255
```

```text
14	func newDoneCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
15		var (
16			ff            bool
17			pr            bool
18			merged        bool
19			deleteBranch  bool
20			keepWorktree  bool
21			push          bool
22			dirtyPolicy   string
23			message       string
24			yes           bool
25			baseRef       string
26			confirmSquash string
27		)
28		cmd := &cobra.Command{
29			Use:   "done [task]",
30			Short: "Integrate a finished change stream without destroying its workspace",
31			Long: `Finish integration while leaving runtime and filesystem cleanup to an
32	external coordinator.
33	
34	  --ff       rebase onto the base and fast-forward it locally. Use when the
35	             branch's commits are worth keeping in the base's history.
36	  --pr       push and open a pull/merge request with the detected forge CLI,
37	             leaving the merge to review and CI.
38	  --merged   verify an externally merged branch against --base-ref, for a merge
39	             performed outside dev.
40	
41	For branch/worktree tasks, omitting every mode opens a finish wizard on an
42	interactive terminal. A non-interactive caller still gets a report and must
43	pass a mode explicitly. Direct tasks need no integration mode.
44	
45	A dirty checkout is analyzed against the base, not rejected as one opaque
46	condition. Interactive use can commit everything, discard everything, or
47	cancel. Unique content requires typing DROP before discard. Scripts select an
48	explicit --dirty policy; destructive discard also requires --yes.
49	
50	A successful local or externally verified merge records DONE, meaning MERGED
51	with cleanup possibly pending. It never closes the invoking runtime, removes a
52	worktree, or deletes a branch. Run dev retire later from outside the workspace.`,
53			Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
54			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
55				modes := 0
56				for _, selected := range []bool{ff, pr, merged} {
57					if selected {
58						modes++
59					}
60				}
61				if modes > 1 {
62					return fmt.Errorf("--ff, --pr and --merged are alternatives; pick one")
63				}
64				if !merged && (baseRef != "" || confirmSquash != "") {
65					return fmt.Errorf("--base-ref and --confirm-squash require --merged")
66				}
67				if deleteBranch {
68					return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branch is cleanup; run dev retire --delete-branch after integration")
69				}
70				if keepWorktree {
71					app.warnf("--keep-worktree is deprecated: dev done always keeps runtime and worktree state")
72				}
73				integration := doneIntegrationNone
74				switch {
75				case ff:
76					integration = doneIntegrationFF
77				case pr:
78					integration = doneIntegrationPR
79				case merged:
80					integration = doneIntegrationMerged
81				}
82				return runDone(ctxOf(), app, args, doneOptions{
83					Integration: integration, DirtyPolicy: doneDirtyPolicy(dirtyPolicy),
84					Message: message, Yes: yes, Push: push,
85					BaseRef: baseRef, ConfirmSquash: confirmSquash,
86				})
87			},
88		}
89		f := cmd.Flags()
90		f.BoolVar(&ff, "ff", false, "rebase onto the base and fast-forward it")
91		f.BoolVar(&pr, "pr", false, "push and open a pull/merge request instead of merging locally")
92		f.BoolVar(&merged, "merged", false, "verify an externally merged branch and mark the task done")
93		f.StringVar(&baseRef, "base-ref", "", "base ref used to verify --merged (default: recorded base)")
94		f.StringVar(&confirmSquash, "confirm-squash", "", "attest that this contained commit represents a squash merge")
95		f.BoolVar(&push, "push", false, "push the resulting base (direct mode pushes its current branch)")
96		f.StringVar(&dirtyPolicy, "dirty", string(doneDirtyAuto), "dirty checkout policy: auto, fail, commit or discard")
97		f.StringVarP(&message, "message", "m", "", "commit message for --dirty=commit")
98		f.BoolVarP(&yes, "yes", "y", false, "confirm the selected finish plan (required for non-interactive discard)")
99		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "dirty", fixedCompletions("auto", "fail", "commit", "discard"))
100		// Both remain accepted so existing scripts fail loudly with a pointer to
101		// dev retire rather than silently skipping cleanup they still expect.
102		f.BoolVar(&keepWorktree, "keep-worktree", false, "deprecated: worktrees are always kept until dev retire")
103		f.BoolVar(&deleteBranch, "delete-branch", false, "deprecated here: use dev retire --delete-branch")
104		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeTasks(app, task.Hot, task.Warm)
105		return cmd
106	}
107	
108	// fastForward rebases the task branch onto its base and then moves the base
109	// forward, producing a linear history with no merge commit.
110	//
111	// merge --ff-only is the guardrail: if the rebase did not actually put the
112	// branch ahead of the base, the merge fails loudly instead of quietly creating
113	// a merge commit the user did not ask for.
114	func fastForward(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout, base string) error {
115		relation, err := gitx.AnalyzeFinish(ctx, checkout, base, t.Branch)
116		if err != nil {
117			return err
118		}
119		if relation.Relation.Contained() {
120			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   integrated  %s is already contained in %s\n", t.Branch, base)
121			return nil
122		}
123		if relation.Relation.BaseOnly > 0 {
124			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   rebasing   %s onto %s\n", t.Branch, base)
125			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rebase", base); err != nil {
126				return fmt.Errorf("%w\n\nThe rebase left conflicts to resolve in %s.\n"+
127					"Fix them, `git rebase --continue`, then re-run dev done --ff",
128					err, config.Contract(checkout))
129			}
130		}
131		// The base branch lives in the main checkout, not the worktree.
132		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   merging    %s into %s (fast-forward only)\n", t.Branch, base)
133		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "switch", base); err != nil {
134			return err
135		}
136		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "merge", "--ff-only", t.Branch); err != nil {
137			return fmt.Errorf("%w\n\n%s could not be fast-forwarded. Something else moved it; "+
138				"rebase again or integrate by hand", err, base)
139		}
140		return nil
141	}
142	
143	// deleteMergedBranch removes a branch only when git agrees its commits are already
144	// contained in the base — the check that makes cleanup safe.
145	func deleteMergedBranch(ctx context.Context, app *App, repoPath, branch, base string) error {
146		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", branch, base); err != nil {
147			return fmt.Errorf("keeping branch %s: it has commits not in %s", branch, base)
148		}
149		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repoPath, "branch", "-d", branch); err != nil {
150			return fmt.Errorf("could not delete %s: %w", branch, err)
151		}
152		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   deleted    branch %s\n", branch)
153		return nil
154	}
155	
156	// openPR pushes the branch and asks the forge CLI to open a pull/merge
157	// request. When no forge CLI is available dev prints the push result and the
158	// URL to open by hand, rather than failing: the branch being published is the
159	// part that actually matters.
160	func openPR(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout, base string) error {
161		if err := pushBranch(ctx, app, checkout, t.Branch); err != nil {
162			return err
163		}
164		kind := forge.Detect(ctx, t.RepoPath)
165		f, err := forge.For(kind)
166		if err != nil || !f.Available() {
167			app.warnf("no forge CLI for this remote — the branch is pushed; open the request in your browser")
168			return nil
169		}
170		url, err := f.CreatePR(ctx, checkout, forge.PRRequest{
171			Base: base, Head: t.Branch, Fill: true,
172		})
173		if err != nil {
174			return err
175		}
176		if url != "" {
177			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   opened     %s\n", url)
178		}
179		return nil
180	}
```

```text
1	package cli
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"os"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
11		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
12		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/task"
13	)
14	
15	type doneIntegration string
16	
17	const (
18		doneIntegrationNone    doneIntegration = ""
19		doneIntegrationFF      doneIntegration = "ff"
20		doneIntegrationPR      doneIntegration = "pr"
21		doneIntegrationMerged  doneIntegration = "merged"
22		doneIntegrationCleanup doneIntegration = "cleanup"
23	)
24	
25	type doneDirtyPolicy string
26	
27	const (
28		doneDirtyAuto    doneDirtyPolicy = "auto"
29		doneDirtyFail    doneDirtyPolicy = "fail"
30		doneDirtyCommit  doneDirtyPolicy = "commit"
31		doneDirtyDiscard doneDirtyPolicy = "discard"
32	)
33	
34	type doneOptions struct {
35		Integration   doneIntegration
36		DirtyPolicy   doneDirtyPolicy
37		Message       string
38		Yes           bool
39		Push          bool
40		BaseRef       string
41		ConfirmSquash string
42	}
43	
44	type donePlan struct {
45		Integration doneIntegration
46		DirtyAction doneDirtyPolicy
47		Message     string
48		Analysis    gitx.FinishAnalysis
49		Prompted    bool
50	}
51	
52	func runDone(ctx context.Context, app *App, args []string, opts doneOptions) error {
53		if opts.DirtyPolicy == "" {
54			opts.DirtyPolicy = doneDirtyAuto
55		}
56		switch opts.DirtyPolicy {
57		case doneDirtyAuto, doneDirtyFail, doneDirtyCommit, doneDirtyDiscard:
58		default:
59			return fmt.Errorf("--dirty %q: want auto, fail, commit or discard", opts.DirtyPolicy)
60		}
61		if opts.Message != "" && opts.DirtyPolicy != doneDirtyCommit && opts.DirtyPolicy != doneDirtyAuto {
62			return errors.New("--message is only used with --dirty=commit")
63		}
64	
65		t, err := resolveTask(app, args)
66		if err != nil {
67			return err
68		}
69		checkout := checkoutOf(t)
70		if _, err := os.Stat(checkout); err != nil {
71			return fmt.Errorf("%s no longer exists — resume the task first", config.Contract(checkout))
72		}
73		if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, checkout); err != nil {
74			return err
75		}
76		mode := t.EffectiveMode()
77		if mode == task.ModeDirect && opts.Integration != doneIntegrationNone {
78			return fmt.Errorf("direct task %s is already on %s; it has no branch/worktree to integrate. "+
79				"Run `dev done` without --ff/--pr/--merged", t.Title(), t.Branch)
80		}
81		base := t.Branch
82		if mode != task.ModeDirect {
83			base = t.Base
84			if base == "" {
85				base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, t.RepoPath)
86			}
87			if base == "" {
88				return fmt.Errorf("cannot determine the base branch for %s — pass --base when starting a task", t.Repo)
89			}
90		}
91	
92		analysis, err := gitx.AnalyzeFinish(ctx, checkout, base, t.Branch)
93		if err != nil {
94			return err
95		}
96		if analysis.Status.Conflicted > 0 {
97			return fmt.Errorf("%s has %d conflicted path(s); resolve or abort the merge/rebase before finishing",
98				config.Contract(checkout), analysis.Status.Conflicted)
99		}
100		interactive := app.interactive()
101		var p *prompter
102		if interactive {
103			p = newPrompter(app)
104			if opts.Integration == doneIntegrationNone || analysis.Status.Dirty() {
105				renderDonePreflight(app, t, base, analysis)
106			}
107		}
108		if mode != task.ModeDirect && opts.Integration == doneIntegrationNone && !interactive {
109			renderDonePreflight(app, t, base, analysis)
110			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Nothing done. Choose an integration mode:")
111			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --ff      rebase when needed, then fast-forward "+base)
112			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --pr      push and open a pull request")
113			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "  dev done --merged  verify a branch that was merged outside dev")
114			return nil
115		}
116	
117		plan, err := buildDonePlan(p, t, base, analysis, opts, interactive)
118		if errors.Is(err, errPromptCanceled) {
119			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Canceled; nothing was changed.")
120			return nil
121		}
122		if err != nil {
123			return err
124		}
125		if plan.Prompted && !opts.Yes {
126			confirmed, err := confirmDonePlan(app, p, t, base, plan)
127			if errors.Is(err, errPromptCanceled) || !confirmed {
128				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Canceled; nothing was changed.")
129				return nil
130			}
131			if err != nil {
132				return err
133			}
134		}
135	
136		fresh, err := gitx.AnalyzeFinish(ctx, checkout, base, t.Branch)
137		if err != nil {
138			return err
139		}
140		if fresh.Fingerprint != plan.Analysis.Fingerprint || fresh.Relation != plan.Analysis.Relation {
141			return errors.New("checkout or branch changed while the finish plan was open; review the new state and rerun dev done")
142		}
143		switch plan.DirtyAction {
144		case doneDirtyCommit:
145			if err := gitx.CommitAllChanges(ctx, checkout, plan.Message); err != nil {
146				return fmt.Errorf("commit dirty checkout: %w", err)
147			}
148		case doneDirtyDiscard:
149			if err := gitx.DiscardAllChanges(ctx, checkout); err != nil {
150				return fmt.Errorf("discard dirty checkout: %w", err)
151			}
152		}
153		analysis, err = gitx.AnalyzeFinish(ctx, checkout, base, t.Branch)
154		if err != nil {
155			return err
156		}
157		if analysis.Status.Dirty() {
158			return fmt.Errorf("%s changed again during finalization: %s; stop the active writer and rerun dev done",
159				config.Contract(checkout), analysis.Status.Breakdown())
160		}
161	
162		if mode == task.ModeDirect {
163			return finishDirectTask(ctx, app, t, checkout, opts.Push)
164		}
165		if plan.Integration == doneIntegrationPR {
166			if analysis.Relation.Contained() {
167				return fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR", t.Branch, base)
168			}
169			if err := openPR(ctx, app, t, checkout, base); err != nil {
170				return err
171			}
172			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nREADY FOR REVIEW · runtime and worktree kept")
173			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "After merge: dev done --merged --base-ref origin/"+base)
174			return nil
175		}
176		if plan.Integration == doneIntegrationMerged {
177			verifyBase := opts.BaseRef
178			if verifyBase == "" {
179				verifyBase = base
180			}
181			proof := t.Branch
182			if opts.ConfirmSquash != "" {
183				proof = opts.ConfirmSquash
184				app.warnf("accepting operator attestation that squash commit %s represents branch %s", opts.ConfirmSquash, t.Branch)
185			}
186			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", proof, verifyBase); err != nil {
187				return fmt.Errorf("cannot verify %s is contained in %s", proof, verifyBase)
188			}
189			return finishIntegratedTask(ctx, app, t, checkout, verifyBase, opts)
190		}
191		if plan.Integration == doneIntegrationFF {
192			// Idempotent: a branch already in the base needs no rebase, only the record.
193			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", t.Branch, base); err == nil {
194				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   already merged  %s is contained in %s\n", t.Branch, base)
195				return finishIntegratedTask(ctx, app, t, checkout, base, opts)
196			}
197		}
198		if err := fastForward(ctx, app, t, checkout, base); err != nil {
199			return err
200		}
201		return finishIntegratedTask(ctx, app, t, checkout, base, opts)
202	}
203	
204	func buildDonePlan(p *prompter, t *task.Task, base string, analysis gitx.FinishAnalysis, opts doneOptions, interactive bool) (donePlan, error) {
205		plan := donePlan{Integration: opts.Integration, Analysis: analysis}
206		if analysis.Status.Dirty() {
207			switch opts.DirtyPolicy {
208			case doneDirtyFail:
209				return plan, dirtyFinishError(t, base, analysis)
210			case doneDirtyAuto:
211				if !interactive {
212					return plan, dirtyFinishError(t, base, analysis)
213				}
214				choice, err := p.choice("Dirty changes (c=commit, d=discard, q=cancel)", "cancel",
215					"commit (c), discard (d), cancel (q)", map[string]string{
216						"c": "commit", "commit": "commit",
217						"d": "discard", "discard": "discard", "drop": "discard",
218						"q": "cancel", "cancel": "cancel",
219					})
220				if err != nil {
221					return plan, err
222				}
223				if choice == "cancel" {
224					return plan, errPromptCanceled
225				}
226				plan.DirtyAction, plan.Prompted = doneDirtyPolicy(choice), true
227			default:
228				plan.DirtyAction = opts.DirtyPolicy
229				if plan.DirtyAction == doneDirtyDiscard && interactive && !opts.Yes {
230					plan.Prompted = true
231				}
232			}
233			if plan.DirtyAction == doneDirtyCommit {
234				plan.Message = strings.TrimSpace(opts.Message)
235				if plan.Message == "" {
236					if !interactive {
237						return plan, errors.New("--message is required with --dirty=commit outside an interactive terminal")
238					}
239					message, err := p.line("Commit message", "chore: finalize "+t.Title())
240					if err != nil {
241						return plan, err
242					}
243					plan.Message, plan.Prompted = strings.TrimSpace(message), true
244				}
245			}
246			if plan.DirtyAction == doneDirtyDiscard && !interactive && !opts.Yes {
247				return plan, errors.New("--dirty=discard outside an interactive terminal requires --yes")
248			}
249		}
250	
251		if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
252			plan.Integration = doneIntegrationCleanup
253			return plan, nil
254		}
255		if plan.Integration == doneIntegrationMerged {
256			return plan, nil
257		}
258		if plan.Integration == doneIntegrationPR && analysis.Relation.Contained() && plan.DirtyAction != doneDirtyCommit {
259			return plan, fmt.Errorf("%s is already contained in %s; use --ff to finalize cleanup instead of opening a PR", t.Branch, base)
260		}
261		if plan.Integration == doneIntegrationNone {
262			if analysis.Relation.Contained() && plan.DirtyAction != doneDirtyCommit {
263				plan.Integration, plan.Prompted = doneIntegrationCleanup, true
264				return plan, nil
265			}
266			if !interactive {
267				return plan, errors.New("choose --ff, --pr or --merged")
268			}
269			choice, err := p.choice("Integration (f=fast-forward, p=PR, q=cancel)", "ff",
270				"fast-forward (f), pull request (p), cancel (q)", map[string]string{
271					"f": "ff", "ff": "ff", "fast-forward": "ff",
272					"p": "pr", "pr": "pr", "pull-request": "pr",
273					"q": "cancel", "cancel": "cancel",
274				})
275			if err != nil {
276				return plan, err
277			}
278			if choice == "cancel" {
279				return plan, errPromptCanceled
280			}
281			plan.Integration, plan.Prompted = doneIntegration(choice), true
282		}
283		return plan, nil
284	}

294	func renderDonePreflight(app *App, t *task.Task, base string, analysis gitx.FinishAnalysis) {
295		s := app.outStyle()
296		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", s.title("Finish"), t.Title())
297		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s      %s\n", s.label("branch"), t.Branch)
298		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("base"), base)
299		switch {
300		case analysis.Relation.BaseOnly == 0 && analysis.Relation.BranchOnly == 0:
301			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already equal to %s (behind 0, ahead 0)", base)))
302		case analysis.Relation.Contained():
303			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.success(fmt.Sprintf("already contained in %s (behind %d, ahead 0)", base, analysis.Relation.BaseOnly)))
304		default:
305			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s     %s\n", s.label("commits"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("behind %d, ahead %d relative to %s",
306				analysis.Relation.BaseOnly, analysis.Relation.BranchOnly, base)))
307		}
308		if !analysis.Status.Dirty() {
309			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.success("clean"))
310			return
311		}
312		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s\n", s.label("checkout"), s.warning(analysis.Status.Breakdown()))
313		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s    %s, %s\n", s.label("contents"),
314			s.success(fmt.Sprintf("%d match %s", analysis.EquivalentDirty(), base)),
315			s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("%d unique", analysis.UniqueDirty())))
316		for _, change := range analysis.Changes {
317			marker := s.warning("unique")
318			if change.BaseEquivalent {
319				marker = s.success("matches " + base)
320			}
321			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s%s %s\n", marker,
322				strings.Repeat(" ", max(0, 12-width(marker))), change.DisplayPath())
323		}
324	}

326	func confirmDonePlan(app *App, p *prompter, t *task.Task, base string, plan donePlan) (bool, error) {
327		s := app.outStyle()
328		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\n"+s.title("Summary"))
329		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s        %s\n", s.label("task"), t.Title())
330		switch plan.DirtyAction {
331		case doneDirtyCommit:
332			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.warning(fmt.Sprintf("commit all as %q", plan.Message)))
333		case doneDirtyDiscard:
334			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.danger("discard all staged, unstaged and untracked changes"))
335		default:
336			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s       %s\n", s.label("dirty"), s.success("none"))
337		}
338		switch plan.Integration {
339		case doneIntegrationPR:
340			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.review("open a PR into "+base))
341		case doneIntegrationCleanup:
342			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("already contained in "+base+"; cleanup only"))
343		default:
344			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s   %s\n", s.label("integrate"), s.success("fast-forward into "+base))
345		}
346		if plan.DirtyAction == doneDirtyDiscard && plan.Analysis.UniqueDirty() > 0 {
347			value, err := p.dangerLine(fmt.Sprintf("Type DROP to discard %d unique path(s)", plan.Analysis.UniqueDirty()))
348			if err != nil {
349				return false, err
350			}
351			return value == "DROP", nil
352		}
353		return p.confirm("Proceed with this finish plan?", false)
354	}

356	func finishDirectTask(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout string, push bool) error {
357		if push {
358			if err := pushBranch(ctx, app, checkout, t.Branch); err != nil {
359				return err
360			}
361		}
362		t.State = task.Done
363		if err := app.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {
364			return err
365		}
366		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s completed directly on %s\n", task.Done.Icon(), t.Title(), t.Branch)
367		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   no branch or worktree was created or removed")
368		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · cleanup pending: run dev retire from outside this runtime")
369		return nil
370	}

372	func finishIntegratedTask(ctx context.Context, app *App, t *task.Task, checkout, base string, opts doneOptions) error {
373		if opts.Push {
374			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, t.RepoPath, "push", "origin", base); err != nil {
375				app.warnf("could not push %s: %v", base, err)
376			} else {

378			}
379		}

381		if err := app.Tasks.Save(t); err != nil {

383		}

385		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "   MERGED · runtime and worktree kept")
386		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   cleanup pending · run `dev retire %s` from outside its workspace\n", t.ID)
```

```text
117	// ProjectRoot uses the current linked-worktree checkout root. Falling back to

120	func ProjectRoot(ctx context.Context, cwd string) string {

145	// List returns a merged, stable inventory. It never downloads the provider;

147	// effect hidden inside a read.
148	func List(ctx context.Context, cwd string, options ListOptions) ([]Skill, error) {
149		root := ProjectRoot(ctx, cwd)
150		p, err := readOnlyProvider()
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154	
155		project, global := options.Project, options.Global
156		if !project && !global {
157			project, global = true, true
158		}
159	
160		projectLock := readLock(filepath.Join(root, "skills-lock.json"))
161		home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
162		globalLock := readLock(filepath.Join(home, ".agents", ".skill-lock.json"))
163	
164		var rows []Skill
165		if project {
166			got, err := listScope(ctx, p, root, ScopeProject, root, projectLock)
167			if err != nil {
168				return nil, err
169			}
170			rows = append(rows, got...)
171		}
172		if global {
173			got, err := listScope(ctx, p, root, ScopeGlobal, home, globalLock)
174			if err != nil {
175				return nil, err
176			}
177			rows = append(rows, got...)
178		}
179	
180		sort.SliceStable(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
181			if rows[i].Scope != rows[j].Scope {
182				return rows[i].Scope == ScopeProject
183			}
184			return strings.ToLower(rows[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(rows[j].Name)
185		})
186		if options.Check {
187			rows = CheckUpdates(ctx, rows)
188		}
189		return rows, nil

232				}
233				if row.SourceType == "" {

235				}
236			} else if row.Name == skill.Name {

255	func findLockEntry(entries map[string]lockEntry, name string) (lockEntry, bool) {
256		if entry, ok := entries[name]; ok {
257			return entry, true
258		}
259		want := normalizedName(name)
260		for key, entry := range entries {
261			if normalizedName(key) == want {
262				return entry, true
263			}
264		}
265		return lockEntry{}, false
266	}
267	
268	func normalizedName(s string) string {
269		s = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(s))
270		var b strings.Builder
271		lastDash := false
272		for _, r := range s {
273			valid := r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9'
274			if valid {
275				b.WriteRune(r)
276				lastDash = false
277			} else if !lastDash {
278				b.WriteByte('-')
279				lastDash = true
280			}
281		}
282		return strings.Trim(b.String(), "-")
283	}

311	// CheckUpdates compares lock-recorded content with the current Git source.
312	// It never invokes `skills update` because that command writes immediately.
313	func CheckUpdates(ctx context.Context, rows []Skill) []Skill {
314		out := append([]Skill(nil), rows...)
315		type member struct {
316			index int
317			url   string
318			ref   string
319		}
320		groups := map[string][]member{}
321		for i := range out {
322			row := &out[i]
323			if row.ManagedBy != ManagedBySkills || row.lock == nil {
324				continue
325			}
326			url, ok := sourceURL(*row.lock)
327			if !ok || row.lock.SkillPath == "" {
328				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
329				row.UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no checkable Git source and skill path"
330				continue
331			}
332			key := url + "\x00" + row.lock.Ref
333			groups[key] = append(groups[key], member{index: i, url: url, ref: row.lock.Ref})
334		}
335	
336		for _, members := range groups {
337			dir, err := cloneSource(ctx, members[0].url, members[0].ref)
338			if err != nil {
339				for _, member := range members {
340					out[member.index].UpdateStatus = UpdateFailed
341					out[member.index].UpdateDetail = "could not fetch source"
342				}
343				continue
344			}
345			for _, member := range members {
346				checkOne(ctx, dir, &out[member.index])
347			}
348			os.RemoveAll(filepath.Dir(dir))
349		}
350		return out
351	}

353	func sourceURL(entry lockEntry) (string, bool) {
354		if entry.SourceType == "local" || entry.SourceType == "node_modules" || entry.SourceType == "well-known" {
355			return "", false
356		}
357		if entry.SourceURL != "" {
358			return entry.SourceURL, true
359		}
360		if entry.SourceType == "github" {
361			parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(entry.Source, "/"), "/")
362			if len(parts) >= 2 {
363				return "https://github.com/" + parts[0] + "/" + parts[1] + ".git", true
364			}
365		}
366		if strings.Contains(entry.Source, "://") || strings.HasSuffix(entry.Source, ".git") {
367			return entry.Source, true
368		}
369		return "", false
370	}

372	func cloneSource(ctx context.Context, url, ref string) (string, error) {
373		parent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-skill-check-*")
374		if err != nil {
375			return "", err
376		}
377		dir := filepath.Join(parent, "source")
378		if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, "", "clone", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "--filter=blob:none", url, dir); err != nil {
379			os.RemoveAll(parent)
380			return "", err
381		}
382		if ref != "" {
383			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "fetch", "--quiet", "--depth", "1", "origin", ref); err != nil {
384				os.RemoveAll(parent)
385				return "", err
386			}
387			if _, err := gitOutput(ctx, dir, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", "FETCH_HEAD"); err != nil {
388				os.RemoveAll(parent)
389				return "", err
390			}
391		}
392		return dir, nil
393	}

395	func checkOne(ctx context.Context, repoDir string, row *Skill) {

405			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
406				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateMissing
407				row.UpdateDetail = "skill path no longer exists upstream"
408			} else {
409				row.UpdateStatus = UpdateFailed
410				row.UpdateDetail = "could not inspect upstream skill path"
411			}
412			return
413		}
414	
415		expected := entry.ComputedHash
416		actual := ""
417		if row.Scope == ScopeGlobal {
418			expected = entry.SkillFolderHash
419			if len(expected) == 40 {
420				spec := "HEAD^{tree}"
421				if folder != "" {
422					spec = "HEAD:" + folder
423				}
424				actual, _ = gitOutput(ctx, repoDir, "rev-parse", spec)
425			} else if len(expected) == 64 {
426				actual, _ = folderHash(abs)
427			}
428		} else if len(expected) == 64 {
429			actual, _ = folderHash(abs)
430		}
431		if expected == "" || actual == "" {
432			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateUnknown
433			row.UpdateDetail = "lock entry has no comparable content hash"
434			return
435		}
436		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(actual), strings.TrimSpace(expected)) {
437			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateCurrent
438			row.UpdateDetail = "matches the recorded upstream content"
439		} else {
440			row.UpdateStatus = UpdateAvailable
441			row.UpdateDetail = "upstream content changed"
442		}

445	func safeSkillFolder(skillPath string) (string, bool) {
446		p := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(skillPath), "\\", "/")
447		if strings.EqualFold(path.Base(p), "SKILL.md") {
448			p = path.Dir(p)
449		}
450		if p == "." {
451			p = ""
452		}
453		clean := path.Clean(p)
454		if clean == "." {
455			clean = ""
456		}
457		if strings.HasPrefix(clean, "/") || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") {
458			return "", false
459		}
460		return clean, true
461	}
462	
463	func folderHash(dir string) (string, error) {
464		type file struct {
465			name string
466			body []byte
467		}
468		var files []file
469		err := filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(filename string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
470			if err != nil {
471				return err
472			}
473			if d.IsDir() && filename != dir && (d.Name() == ".git" || d.Name() == "node_modules") {
474				return filepath.SkipDir
475			}
476			if d.Type().IsRegular() {
477				body, err := os.ReadFile(filename)
478				if err != nil {
479					return err
480				}
481				rel, err := filepath.Rel(dir, filename)
482				if err != nil {
483					return err
484				}
485				files = append(files, file{name: filepath.ToSlash(rel), body: body})
486			}
487			return nil
488		})
489		if err != nil {
490			return "", err
491		}
492		sort.Slice(files, func(i, j int) bool { return files[i].name < files[j].name })
493		h := sha256.New()
494		for _, f := range files {
495			_, _ = io.WriteString(h, f.name)
496			_, _ = h.Write(f.body)
497		}
498		return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
499	}
500	
501	func readOnlyProvider() (provider, error) {
502		if bin, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
503			return provider{bin: bin, label: "skills"}, nil
504		}
505		if bin, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
506			return provider{bin: bin, prefix: []string{"--no-install", "skills"}, label: "npx --no-install skills"}, nil
507		}
508		return provider{}, errors.New("skills provider unavailable — run `dev skill add` once or install the `skills` npm package")
509	}
510	
511	func interactiveProvider() (provider, error) {
512		if bin, err := exec.LookPath("skills"); err == nil {
513			return provider{bin: bin, label: "skills"}, nil
514		}
515		if bin, err := exec.LookPath("npx"); err == nil {
516			return provider{bin: bin, prefix: []string{"skills"}, label: "npx skills"}, nil
517		}
518		return provider{}, errors.New("neither `skills` nor `npx` is available")
519	}
520	
521	func (p provider) command(ctx context.Context, cwd string, args ...string) *exec.Cmd {
522		all := append(append([]string(nil), p.prefix...), args...)
523		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, p.bin, all...)
524		cmd.Dir = cwd
525		return cmd
526	}
527	
528	func (p provider) output(ctx context.Context, cwd string, args ...string) ([]byte, string, error) {
529		cmd := p.command(ctx, cwd, args...)
530		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
531		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
532		err := cmd.Run()
533		return stdout.Bytes(), stderr.String(), err
534	}
535	
536	// AddCommand opens the upstream interactive installer in projectRoot.
537	func AddCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, source string) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
538		if source == "" {
539			source = DefaultSource
540		}
541		p, err := interactiveProvider()
542		if err != nil {
543			return nil, err
544		}
545		return p.command(ctx, projectRoot, "add", source), nil
546	}
547	
548	// UpdateCommand updates exactly one lock-managed skill in exactly one scope.
549	func UpdateCommand(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, name string, scope Scope) (*exec.Cmd, error) {
550		if name == "" {
551			return nil, errors.New("skill name is required")
552		}
553		if scope != ScopeProject && scope != ScopeGlobal {
554			return nil, errors.New("skill update requires project or global scope")
555		}
556		p, err := interactiveProvider()
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, err
559		}
560		args := []string{"update", name, "--yes"}
561		if scope == ScopeGlobal {
562			args = append(args, "--global")
563		} else {
564			args = append(args, "--project")
565		}
566		return p.command(ctx, projectRoot, args...), nil
567	}
568	
569	// ProviderVersion checks the same no-download provider used for listing.
570	func ProviderVersion(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (string, error) {
571		p, err := readOnlyProvider()
572		if err != nil {
573			return "", err
574		}
575		out, errOut, err := p.output(ctx, cwd, "--version")
576		if err != nil {
577			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", p.label, strings.TrimSpace(errOut))
578		}
579		return p.label + " " + strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
580	}
581	
582	func gitOutput(ctx context.Context, dir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
583		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", args...)
584		cmd.Dir = dir
585		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
586		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &stdout, &stderr
587		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
588			return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s failed: %s", args[0], strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
589		}
590		return strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()), nil
591	}
```

```text
195	
196	func pathCheck(p string) (checkStatus, string) {
197		info, err := os.Stat(p)
198		switch {
199		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
200			return checkOK, config.Contract(p)
201		case os.IsNotExist(err):
202			return checkWarn, config.Contract(p) + " (will be created on first use)"
203		case err != nil:
204			return checkFail, err.Error()
205		default:
206			return checkFail, config.Contract(p) + " is not a directory"
207		}
208	}
209	
210	// writableNote reports whether dev could actually create a worktree under the
211	// configured root, walking up to the nearest existing ancestor. A root on an
212	// unmounted volume or a read-only mount is the failure this catches early,
213	// before a `dev wt create` gets halfway through.
214	func writableNote(root string) string {
215		dir := root
216		for {
217			if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil {
218				if !info.IsDir() {
219					return "not a directory"
220				}
221				if dirWritable(dir) {
222					return "writable"
223				}
224				return "NOT WRITABLE"
225			}
226			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
227			if parent == dir {
228				return "unreachable"
229			}
230			dir = parent
231		}
232	}
233	
234	// dirWritable probes by creating and removing a temp file. There is no
235	// portable stdlib permission check, and the mode bits alone would lie about
236	// read-only mounts and ACLs.
237	func dirWritable(dir string) bool {
238		f, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".dev-write-probe-*")
239		if err != nil {
240			return false
241		}
242		name := f.Name()
243		f.Close()
244		os.Remove(name)
245		return true
246	}
247
```

```text
func newFleetListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var hostNames []string
	var repoQuery string
	var jsonOut, cachedOnly, strict bool
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "list",
		Short: "List repositories and activity across this machine and configured hosts",
		Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			selected := map[string]bool{}
			for _, name := range hostNames {

			}
			results, _, err := collectFleet(ctxOf(), app, fleetCollectOptions{CachedOnly: cachedOnly, Hosts: selected})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if jsonOut {
				encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
				encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
				if err := encoder.Encode(results); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			} else {

func renderFleetList(app *App, results []fleet.HostResult, query string) {
	table := NewTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPO", "BRANCH", "GIT", "LIVE", "TASKS", "LATEST", "PATH")
	needle := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
	for _, result := range results {
		if result.Snapshot == nil || len(result.Snapshot.Repositories) == 0 {
			table.Add(result.Name, string(result.State), "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", "—", truncate(result.Error, 42))
			continue
		}
		for _, repository := range result.Snapshot.Repositories {
			haystack := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{repository.Name, repository.Display, repository.Branch, repository.Path, strings.Join(repository.RemoteIdentities, " ")}, " "))
			if needle != "" && !strings.Contains(haystack, needle) {
				continue
			}
			live := ""
			if repository.Live {
				live = repository.Runtime
				if repository.AgentStatus != "" {
					live += ":" + repository.AgentStatus
				}
			}
			latest := "—"
			if !repository.LastActivity.IsZero() {
				latest = humanAge(time.Since(repository.LastActivity))
			}
			table.Add(result.Name, string(result.State), truncate(repository.Display, 28), truncate(repository.Branch, 22),
				repository.Status.Summary(), dash(live), fleetTaskSummary(repository.Tasks), latest, config.Contract(repository.Path))
		}
	}
	table.Render(app.Out)
}

func fleetRows(results []fleet.HostResult) []tui.FleetRow {
	var rows []tui.FleetRow
	for _, result := range results {
		if result.Snapshot == nil || len(result.Snapshot.Repositories) == 0 {
			rows = append(rows, tui.FleetRow{Host: result.Name, Local: result.Local, State: result.State, Error: result.Error, FromCache: result.FromCache})
			continue
		}
		for index := range result.Snapshot.Repositories {
			repository := result.Snapshot.Repositories[index]
			rows = append(rows, tui.FleetRow{
				Host: result.Name, Local: result.Local, State: result.State, Repository: &repository,
				Error: result.Error, FromCache: result.FromCache,
			})
		}
	}
	return rows
}

func cachedFleetRows(app *App) []tui.FleetRow {
	cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
	if err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var results []fleet.HostResult
	for _, host := range cfg.Hosts {
		snapshot, cachedAt, ok := fleet.LoadCache(host)
		if !ok || (cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration > 0 && time.Since(cachedAt) > cfg.Defaults.CacheTTL.Duration) {
			continue
		}
		results = append(results, fleet.HostResult{
			Name: host.Name, State: fleet.HostStale, Snapshot: &snapshot,
			CachedAt: &cachedAt, FromCache: true,
		})
	}
	return fleetRows(results)
}

func fleetTaskSummary(counts fleet.TaskCounts) string {
	var parts []string
	for _, item := range []struct {
		icon string
		n    int
	}{{"🔥", counts.Hot}, {"🌤", counts.Warm}, {"❄", counts.Cold}, {"✓", counts.Done}} {
		if item.n > 0 {
			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", item.icon, item.n))
		}
	}
	return dash(strings.Join(parts, " "))
}

func newFleetStatusCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var jsonOut, strict bool
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "status",
		Short: "Probe configured hosts and report snapshot health",
		Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			results, cfg, err := collectFleet(ctxOf(), app, fleetCollectOptions{})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if jsonOut {
				encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
				encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
				if err := encoder.Encode(results); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			} else {
				table := NewTable("HOST", "STATE", "REPOS", "SNAPSHOT", "DETAIL")
				for _, result := range results {
					repos, age := "—", "—"
					if result.Snapshot != nil {
						repos = fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(result.Snapshot.Repositories))
						age = humanAge(time.Since(result.Snapshot.GeneratedAt))
					}
					table.Add(result.Name, string(result.State), repos, age, truncate(result.Error, 72))
				}
				table.Render(app.Out)
				if len(cfg.Hosts) == 0 {
					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\nNo remote hosts configured; edit %s\n", config.Contract(fleetConfigPath(app)))
				}
			}
			if strict && anyStrictFleetFailure(results) {
				return errors.New("one or more fleet hosts could not be verified")
			}
			return nil
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON")
	cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&strict, "strict", false, "fail when a host is unreachable or incompatible")
	return cmd
}

func anyStrictFleetFailure(results []fleet.HostResult) bool {
	for _, result := range results {
		if result.StrictFailure() {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func newFleetConfigCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "config", Short: "Show, edit, initialise and locate remotes.toml"}
	cmd.AddCommand(
		&cobra.Command{Use: "path", Short: "Print the remotes config path", Args: cobra.NoArgs, RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			path := app.remotesPath
			if path == "" {
				path = fleet.ConfigFile()

			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, config.Expand(path))
			return nil
		}},
		&cobra.Command{Use: "show", Short: "Print the effective remotes configuration", Args: cobra.NoArgs, RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			cfg, err := loadFleetConfig(app)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for index := range cfg.Hosts {
				if cfg.Hosts[index].PasswordKind() == "plain" {
					cfg.Hosts[index].SSHLoginPasswordSource.Value = "(redacted)"
				}
			}
			return toml.NewEncoder(app.Out).Encode(cfg)
		}},

	)

}

const fleetStarterConfig = `# dev remote fleet configuration.
schema_version = 1

[defaults]
connect_timeout = "15s"
command_timeout = "5m"
cache_ttl = "15m"
max_parallel = 4
dev_path = "auto"

# Prefer an alias from ~/.ssh/config so ProxyJump, IdentityAgent and host-key
# policy behave exactly like an ordinary ssh invocation.
# [[hosts]]
# name = "lab"
# ssh_alias = "lab"

# Explicit connection fields are also supported. Password login is retried only
# after key/agent authentication is rejected.
# [[hosts]]
# name = "vps"
# hostname = "203.0.113.10"
# user = "dev"
# port = 22
# identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
# ssh_login_password_source = { type = "bitwarden", item = "ssh-vps-login" }
`

func fleetConfigPath(app *App) string {
	if app.remotesPath != "" {
		return config.Expand(app.remotesPath)
	}
	return fleet.ConfigFile()
}

func newFleetConfigInitCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var force, stdout bool
	cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "init", Short: "Write a starter remotes.toml", Args: cobra.NoArgs, RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		if stdout {
			fmt.Fprint(app.Out, fleetStarterConfig)
			return nil
		}
		path := fleetConfigPath(app)
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !force {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists (use --force to overwrite)", config.Contract(path))
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(fleetStarterConfig), 0o600); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n", config.Contract(path))
		return nil
	}}
	cmd.Flags().BoolVarP(&force, "force", "f", false, "overwrite an existing file")
	cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&stdout, "stdout", false, "print without writing")
	return cmd
}

func newFleetConfigEditCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var editor string
	cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "edit", Short: "Open remotes.toml in $VISUAL or $EDITOR", Args: cobra.NoArgs, RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		path := fleetConfigPath(app)
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); os.IsNotExist(err) {
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(fleetStarterConfig), 0o600); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		chosen, err := resolveEditor(editor)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		process := exec.Command(shellPath(), "-c", chosen+" "+shellQuote(path))
		process.Stdin, process.Stdout, process.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
		return process.Run()
	}}
	cmd.Flags().StringVar(&editor, "editor", "", "editor command override")
	return cmd
}
```

```text
27		cmd.AddCommand(newCacheListCmd(app), newCachePathCmd(app), newCacheClearCmd(app))
28		return cmd
29	}
30	
31	func cacheRoot() string { return filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev") }
32	
33	func newCachePathCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
34		return &cobra.Command{
35			Use:   "path",
36			Short: "Print dev's XDG cache directory",
37			Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
38			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
39				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, cacheRoot())
40				return nil
41			},
42		}
43	}
44	
45	func newCacheListCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
46		return &cobra.Command{
47			Use:   "list",
48			Short: "List cache paths, sizes, and ages",
49			Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				t := app.newTable("CACHE", "SIZE", "AGE", "PATH")
52				style := app.outStyle()
53				for _, item := range cacheItems() {
54					size, modified, exists := cacheInfo(item.path)
55					if !exists {
56						t.Add(item.name, "—", "—", style.dim(config.Contract(item.path)+" (absent)"))
57						continue
58					}
59					t.Add(item.name, humanBytes(size), humanAge(time.Since(modified)), config.Contract(item.path))
60				}
61				t.Render(app.Out)
62				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\nStats data: %s (not cache; use `dev stats clear`)\n",
63					config.Contract(filepath.Join(app.Cfg.StateDir(), "stats.db")))
64				return nil
65			},
66		}
67	}
68	
69	type cacheItem struct{ name, path string }
70	
71	func cacheItems() []cacheItem {
72		return []cacheItem{
73			{"remote", filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "remotes.json")},
74			{"notes", filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "notes.db")},
75			{"fleet", fleet.CacheRoot()},
76			{"size", filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "sizes-v1.json")},
77			{"gitignore", filepath.Join(cacheRoot(), "gitignore")},
78		}
79	}
80	
81	func newCacheClearCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
82		return &cobra.Command{
83			Use:       "clear <remote|notes|fleet|size|gitignore|all>",
84			Short:     "Remove a regenerable cache",
85			Args:      cobra.ExactArgs(1),
86			ValidArgs: []string{"remote", "notes", "fleet", "size", "gitignore", "all"},
87			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
88				name := args[0]
89				if name == "remotes" {
90					name = "remote"
91				}
92				if name == "sizes" {
93					name = "size"
94				}
95				var targets []cacheItem
96				for _, item := range cacheItems() {
97					if name == "all" || item.name == name {
98						targets = append(targets, item)
99					}
100				}
101				if len(targets) == 0 {
102					return fmt.Errorf("unknown cache %q: want remote, notes, fleet, size, gitignore or all", args[0])
103				}
104				removed := 0
105				for _, item := range targets {
106					if _, err := os.Lstat(item.path); os.IsNotExist(err) {
107						continue
108					}
109					if err := os.RemoveAll(item.path); err != nil {
110						return fmt.Errorf("clear %s: %w", item.name, err)
111					}
112					if item.name == "notes" {
113						for _, suffix := range []string{"-wal", "-shm"} {
114							if err := os.Remove(item.path + suffix); err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
115								return fmt.Errorf("clear notes%s: %w", suffix, err)
116							}
117						}
118					}
119					removed++
120				}
121				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "cleared %d cache(s) under %s\n", removed, config.Contract(cacheRoot()))
122				return nil
123			},
124		}
125	}
126	
127	func cacheInfo(path string) (size int64, modified time.Time, exists bool) {
128		info, err := os.Stat(path)
129		if err != nil {
130			return 0, time.Time{}, false
131		}
132		exists, modified = true, info.ModTime()
133		if !info.IsDir() {
134			return info.Size(), modified, true
135		}
136		_ = filepath.WalkDir(path, func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
137			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
138				return nil
139			}
140			if i, err := d.Info(); err == nil {
141				size += i.Size()
142				if i.ModTime().After(modified) {
143					modified = i.ModTime()
144				}
145			}
146			return nil
147		})
148		return size, modified, true
149	}
150	
151	func humanBytes(n int64) string {
152		const unit = 1024
153		switch {
154		case n < unit:
155			return fmt.Sprintf("%dB", n)
156		case n < unit*unit:
157			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fK", float64(n)/unit)
158		case n < unit*unit*unit:
159			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fM", float64(n)/(unit*unit))
160		default:
161			return fmt.Sprintf("%.1fG", float64(n)/(unit*unit*unit))
162		}
163	}
164
```
